review.content_class_rationale: Rendered and viewed the single PDF page: the CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report (items 1-13 with a Reported on Line column holding x marks, one 'unable to obtain' entry for the patient perspective, a ticked Yes consent box and a short consent statement). It is a manuscript reporting checklist, not clinical data.

estimated_counts.basis: machine page count of the PDF; the one page was rendered and viewed

review.notes: Reporting-guideline checklist for the manuscript; the line-reference column holds x marks and no patient clinical values. Its printed consent note is administrative and is not recorded as a clinical fact.
limitations: Single rendered page viewed at reduced and full resolution; the small consent note below the table was read as printed and is not transcribed as clinical data.
Machine draft: every review block must be completed by a reviewer who inspected the content.
